content: Insert one suppository containing phenylephrine and cocoa butter rectally. This may be done up to four times daily, particularly at night, in the morning, or after a bowel movement that could worsen hemorrhoids. To use, detach one suppository from the strip and remove the foil wrapper by following these steps: 1. Hold the suppository with the rounded end facing upward. 2. Carefully separate the foil tabs by inserting the tip of a fingernail at the end marked peel down. 3. Slowly and evenly peel apart the foil by pulling the tabs down both sides without tearing, exposing the suppository. 4. Remove the exposed suppository from the wrapper. 5. Insert one suppository into the rectum. This can be repeated up to four times daily, especially at night, in the morning, or after each bowel movement. For children under 12 years of age, use is dependent on the patient’s condition and whether the benefits outweigh the risks. For individuals aged 12 years or older, insert one suppository rectally, following the same instructions, up to four times daily as needed. This product is for rectal use only. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage unless directed by a healthcare professional. Discontinue use and consult a physician if hemorrhoids worsen or do not improve within seven days. Stop use immediately if you experience bleeding, an allergic reaction, redness, irritation, swelling, pain, or other symptoms that develop or worsen. Keep this product out of the reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. Phenylephrine is an alpha-adrenergic agonist that works by causing localized vasoconstriction, thereby reducing inflammation. Cocoa butter provides moisturizing and lubricating effects. This product is generally considered safe for use during pregnancy, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Copyright © 2010 First DataBank, Inc.
